# hikaku sitatter

> > An interactive web tool for creating visual height comparison charts between people, characters, and objects.

hikaku sitatter (身長比較したったー) is a popular Japanese visualization tool created by hot/hakano that allows users to generate comparison charts by inputting heights. The service is available in multiple languages and supports sharing comparisons via social media platforms including Twitter, Facebook, and Pixiv.

## Key Topics

- height comparison
- interactive visualization
- character comparison
- comparison chart generator
- measurement converter
- visual height calculator
- screenshot sharing
- multi-language support
- Twitter integration
- SNS sharing
- Pixiv compatibility
- web-based tool
- hot/hakano (creator)

## Main Tool

- [身長比較したったー｜身長の比較図が作れる便利ツール](https://hikaku-sitatter.com): Homepage: Interactive height comparison tool for creating visual charts of people, characters, and objects (Japanese)
- [hikaku sitatter - height comparison chart](https://hikaku-sitatter.com/en): Height comparison tool - English language version

## International Versions

- [hikaku sitatter - Comparación de estaturas](https://hikaku-sitatter.com/es): Height comparison tool - Spanish language version
- [hikaku sitatter｜그림 그릴때 키를 한눈에 비교할수 있는 편리한 툴](https://hikaku-sitatter.com/ko): Height comparison tool - Korean language version
